document.title: Work queue
document.p: Kept by the orchestrator. Newest state first; each change is its own commit. Numbers are release-build passes from docs/CONFORMANCE.md.

item.p: Phases 0–5 and 7 closed by agent review (, , , , , ); fuzzing at length and the full lint wait for the owner's machine (). 7.11's gate (all 12 XT40 transform cases) is open: 10 pass; transform-004 needs a suspendable compiler (), transform-401 waits on 4.22's newest-draft patterns ().

Passes (release, whole suites at e74d4ad, report-1, docs/CONFORMANCE.md): XP40 32,815 (26 failed), XQ40 46,158 (74), XT40 12,268 (250), XSD11 41,599 of 41,610 run (11), iXML 886 of 907 (21 not run), tree-sitter 1,410 of 1,438 (8 failed, 1 corpus error). Zero errors in the W3C suites. Gate rates: XP40 99.8 %, XQ40 99.8 %, XT40 96.7 %, XSD 100.0 %. tools/conformance-report.py has no iXML or tree-sitter sections yet.

One build with everything (, size-3): every shipped build has every language and optional feature; the JavaScript package ships one sxml.wasm (7,701,002 / 1,713,241 bytes; budget 8,000,000 / 2,800,000; ./sxml-full.wasm is an alias). CLI budget 9,500,000 / 2,100,000. The size test compares the module's linker map with a baseline and prints the top growths (). fn:load-xquery-module serves every language.
EXPath Binary () 646 of 646 and File () 270 of 270 in XQ40; File needs --allow-file-access in the CLI and has no Windows implementation.

section.title: Running
section.p: Priorities (): 1. conformance, 2. a mise task building the CLI for every supported platform, 3. the user-facing book. Phase 6 is paused (bindings/kotlin/DESIGN.md, bindings/swift/DESIGN.md).
(Book-first pages carry <!-- status: draft -->; check-book-examples.sh skips them unless --drafts.)

item.p: perf-5 done (): slices of a stored sequence share their items; 100 walks over 780 elements 10.2 / 2.6 / 3.0 s to 0.11 s for [position() > 1] / tail / subsequence, QT4 XP40, XQ40 and XT40 unchanged case by case. SchXslt's expand stage of EN 16931: 8 min 56 s before perf-5 and perf-6; 7 min 38 s unpatched now (its own re-sorts); 14.8 s with SchXslt's sort-once fix (was 1 min 39 s), output identical. Left: slices of concatenations and lazy sequences copy once; fn:remove($s, 1) and $s[position() != 1] still loop; the memo keeps one matched vector per item type.
The step limit: the patched expand stage needs more than the default 10^8 steps (it stops after 2 s); the CLI has no way to raise it. A CLI option is for the owner ("## Proposed" when written up).
Also open under "Proposed" in DECISIONS.md: source locations for parsed input documents.
perf-6 done (): a regex cache per evaluation; compiling was under 1 % of SchXslt's expand stage. Left: tests/bench/regex-reuse.xq is not yet in run-bench.py (perf-5 holds that file).

perf-7 done (): faster regex matching. With perf-5, perf-6 and perf-7, SchXslt's expand stage with its sort-once fix takes 10.5 s (75.3 x 10^9 instructions; was 14.8 s, and 1 min 39 s before perf-5). Left: an error record not cleared after a caught FORX0002, so a later LIMIT_EXCEEDED in the same query prints the old description.

7.30 done (): 514 cases, 2025-only cases checked independently. 7.29 done (): source locations, AUTOMATIC by default; left: the JavaScript locations option is written and tested but was not built (no WASI SDK in the session), and under AUTOMATIC a program that only raises errors naming nodes keeps no locations ('s list has no fn:error). 7.28 (Schematron) can start: 7.27, 7.29, 7.30 and cli-4 are done.
The owner's decisions of 2026-10-28 are : Schematron's open points, source locations (packet , after ), no step limit in the sxml command (packet , runs now), SchXslt's fix not offered upstream.

7.27 (design, for the owner's review) and then 7.28: Schematron as a front end that builds the XSLT AST (owner, 2026-10-28). Starts after and ; the e-invoicing work can use the official pre-compiled EN 16931 stylesheets until then.

perf-8 done (, coercion 33 % to 18 % of the profile) and perf-9 done (, regex search 12.9 % to 0.4 %). SchXslt's expand stage of EN 16931: 7.7–8.5 s with its sort-once fix, 4 min 51 s unpatched (8 min 56 s this morning); output identical.
perf-10 done (): relabelled casts, choices of one item; SchXslt's expand stage 52.19 to 47.78 x 10^9 instructions, about 6.7 s.
fix-4 done (): choices try every alternative (XPath 4.0, 3.4.2); a caught error no longer leaves its description in the record. Left: code that drops an error outside a catching task is not audited.
perf-11 done (): about 1 %; the rest of atomization's cost is in the atomic cell (allocation 4.3 %, a second UTF-8 check 2.5 %, type lookup 1 %), proposed in .

7.28 done (, ): Schematron natively, 7.30's suite 463 of 463 applicable (3 listed deviations), EN 16931 UBL 1,133 of 1,133 from the .sch sources, compile 0.53–0.59 s. Waiting for the owner (Proposed in DECISIONS): EN 16931 CII (a parameter named twice) and XRechnung (pattern variables used schema-wide, let after assertions, an undeclared xs prefix) are not correct Schematron and are refused. Left: with --schema, findings run on the validated copy and lose line numbers; a dynamic error in an expression rule context has no location; the JavaScript API was not built (no WASI SDK).
perf-12 done (): compile passes linear; invoice 2.68 to 2.08 x 10^9 instructions (0.29–0.37 s).
perf-13 done (): component graph linear, value templates without braces, the Schematron builder parses once; validate --schematron on an invoice about 0.41 s (was 0.59–0.73).
perf-14 done (): the Schematron walk visits only the node kinds its rules can match; invoice validation 1.21 to 0.48 x 10^9 instructions (the official stylesheet: 0.55), about 0.3 s.
perf-15 done (): rules indexed by kind and name; invoice transform 0.21-0.23 s, validate --schematron 0.24 s, many-rules benchmark 7.0 to 0.46 s.

perf-16 done (, the IR passes walk each body once) and perf-17 done (, fewer grammar reductions, each XPath text parsed once per compilation). validate --schematron on one EN 16931 invoice: 1.12 x 10^9 instructions, about 0.20 s; the pre-compiled stylesheet about 0.18 s. Left for later packets: the demand pass (0.10), owners made in four passes, verify, the global-read pass (); sxml.wasm not built in this session (no WASI SDK), its size budget unchecked after 's tables (+about 206 KB).

fix-6 done (the count drifted with later packets, stable per build; the book shows 194). book-30 done: the Schematron part (seven chapters on the Vane story), published to sxml.tinyactors.dev from efd5d4ddc on 2026-10-29.

fix-7 done (): F&O's prefixes (xs, fn, math, , , err) resolve without ns (binding Annexes H to L); every finding names its document (text, JSON, C, JavaScript); real rule sets' known deviations are warnings (schematron:compatibility), so EN 16931 CII and XRechnung compile from their sources and run in ctest. Left: a pattern let defined only in a pattern the phase leaves out is not shared (XPST0008; not against the standard, which scopes pattern variables to their pattern, 3.23, and SchXslt does the same); the differential against SchXslt runs in ctest only with SXML_SCHEMATRON_DIFFERENTIAL=ON (minutes per rule set); the JavaScript API typechecked only.
wasm-1 (build and test the JavaScript package; wasi-sdk-34 now at /opt/wasi-sdk) runs now.

Conformance baselines differ by setup: 7.29 () measured XP40 32,815, XQ40 46,158, XT40 12,283 before and after; perf-8, perf-10 and fix-4 measured 32,785, 46,114, 12,185 before and after on the same code. Each run is consistent, so no packet changed an outcome, but the setups differ (cause unverified; XP40's 32,815 equals the owner's report). Compare only against a base measured in the same setup and session, and name the setup (environment variables, drivers' options) in the record.

Leftovers without a packet: the error record is not cleared after a caught FORX0002, so a later LIMIT_EXCEEDED prints the old description (perf-7); c.md's memory example prints 197 allocations where the book shows 195 (also before cli-4); an exceeded limit exits 4, the status for internal errors (cli-4; the owner chose exit 1 for unsupported Schematron constructs, 's revision).

Sorting was measured and is not a problem: 780 elements sort in about 1.3 ms (xsl:sort) or 1.8 ms (fn:sort). SchXslt's 7 minutes were its own 800,000 re-sorts; the fix (sort once in schxslt:replace-params) belongs upstream, for the owner to offer.

The book on Vane is done (book-5..book-21, book-13): 18 chapters, 882 examples, mdbook build clean. Conformance appendix numbers date from 20 October (a new report run would refresh them).

section.title: Leftovers no packet owns yet
section.p: Kotlin (6.4/6.5 done, , ): 65 tests on the JVM with -Xcheck:jni and 0 leaks; the host shim now refuses U+0000, U+FFFE, U+FFFF. 6.6 (AAR) after ; Kotlin's SchemaException subclasses SxmlException, Swift's SchemaError does not (6.12 to compare).
Swift (6.7/6.8 done, , ): 55 tests on Linux; the bundled DUCET is a copy of third_party/unicode-collation/allkeys.txt that must be updated with it.

XPath and XQuery (2.28, ): syntax errors reported at the inner ERROR node (string constructors no longer 1:1); run-time closures carry module and focus (one mechanism for XQuery and XSLT); 's limit lifted (a fresh global table after the evaluation ends); focus-free defaults computed once; item types across module cycles. XQ40 46,154 -> 46,158 (74 failed). What is left is kept on purpose () or singletons.

XPath and XQuery (2.27, ): XInclude for fn:doc, fn:parse-xml and fn:document (no xpointer); Japanese ideographic numerals; element() no longer selects JNodes. XP40 32,809 -> 32,815 (26 failed), XQ40 46,138 -> 46,154 (78 failed). Left: xqhof18/19 (run-time closures carrying module and focus), modules-43 (types imported in a cycle), function-decl-40-060, record-003/-005/-016 (draft rejects surplus entries), fn-string-length-26 (contradicts XDM 7.5.2.4), 4 XP40 cases relying on XQuery-only character references.

XPath and XQuery (2.26, ): XP40 32,797 -> 32,809 (31 failed), XQ40 46,101 -> 46,138 (90 failed). A resolver may answer a module import with a SEQUENCE of locations (processor.h, xquery.h contract widened). stands (xs:numeric under 1.0 compatibility: the draft limits fn:number conversion to xs:double). Left: xqhof18/19 (run-time function-lookup items' static context), eqname-007, modules-43. Cheap not-run features: fn:doc use-xsi-schema-location (to 5.16), CJK numerals, XInclude.

XML 1.1 query text (processor.h reads_query_text_as_xml_1_1, additive; the QT4 driver sets it, the CLI keeps 1.0). section.p: XSLT (after 4.20, ; XT40 11,912): merge 107/120, error 474/580, validation 51/68, namespace 217/224, normalize-unicode 18/18. Left: XTDE3490; merge-097 (Saxon collection URI); xml-version-007 (value-template grammar rejects XML 1.1 controls); namespace-2606/-6202; docbook-004; fn-transform-27/82e/94; xsl:copy of JNodes (needs an xdm.h addition); XTDE0430/0440; 4.22 (): the newest drafts (13 Oct 2026, qtspecs 72f2229) and xslt40-test (91328fb) are what sxml already had; 57 suite cases contradict the draft (53 "~T" type patterns that PR 2911 removed, 4 priorities, match-080/239) and the draft wins (; the owner confirmed on 2026-10-20: no "~T" extension). typed="~T" on xsl:mode added. Refresh both together when qtspecs or the suite move. 4.21 (): indexed FILTERs are not hoisted from; current-merge-group(()) per 15.5.1; globals computed on first read (GLOBAL_READ); typed modes and XTSE3105; XT40 11,943 at its last run. Left: document-4066 (fn:document's schema validation does not raise FODC0002); a global's side effects now happen at its first read.

XSLT (4.32, ): XT40 12,273 -> 12,283 passed, 235 failed. XTSE3155, fn:filter's streamability, fn:snapshot keeps base URI and unparsed entities, document-node(element(N, T)) tests the annotation, input-type-annotations after validation. The newest draft moves streamability into a separate XSLT Streaming 4.0 specification. Of 54 streaming failures: 9 fixed, 37 decided by the draft or the suite, 8 left (accumulator-061, capture-206, six merge cases). Streamed snapshot over 13 MB: 8.5 MB resident.

XSLT (4.31, ): XT40 12,268 -> 12,273 passed, 245 failed. copy-4308, map-for-key-005, accumulators and fn:function-lookup per package, document-2401 (strip-space per package; one document per URI and preparation). Namespace undeclarations need no tree.h change ( already stores them; namespace-2606's expected file is indented, a suite issue). Left: function-lookup-005 (the packages' use relation), import-schema-216 (schema roles), merge-when, streaming (4.32).

XSLT (4.30, ): XT40 12,261 -> 12,268 passed, 250 failed; key-004 lost to the draft (20.2.2 note: keys compare by fn:atomic-equal). split-when via fn:partition; one XSLT closure mechanism; new-each-time="no" cached; adaptive character maps. Left: map-for-key-005 (to 2.28), copy-4308, function-lookup and accumulators per package, per-package strip-space for fn:document, schema roles kept apart (import-schema-216), merge-when. Streaming: about 20 single causes (~a week). Namespace undeclarations: an additive tree.h binding with an empty URI (4.31).

XSLT (4.29, ): XT40 12,250 -> 12,261 passed (99 wrong error), 257 failed. Of what is left: 112 the draft decides, 42 suite or environment, about 130 failed and 72 wrong error real gaps. Small: xsl:evaluate codes (12), package/override static codes (~20), serialization (~10), map-for-key with empty $top, copy-4308. Medium: schema-aware validation codes (~20), record coercion (12, to 2.27), 's document items, new-each-time="no", split-when/merge-when, function-lookup visibility per package. Large: streaming (~20), namespace undeclarations in the tree (namespace-2606). self::element() selecting JNodes to 2.27.

XSLT (4.28, ): XT40 12,239 -> 12,250 passed, 268 failed. XSLT instruction errors carry module and line ('s XTTE gap closed). Left: FORG0001 in parameter/variable coercion casts (4), XTTE0945 when the focus is absent only at run time (2), an attribute set inside xsl:for-each of a rule still sees the rule; xs:numeric under 1.0 compatibility given to 2.26 (check against ). About 17 cases the draft decides.

XSLT (4.27, ): XT40 12,210 -> 12,226 by its own changes; 12,239 passed, 279 failed at 92a8a8c with 2.25's first commits. Left: xsl:next-match in attribute sets (2), per-package strip-space for fn:document (document-2401), fragment identifiers in xsl:source-document (docbook-003/004), strip-space "none" returning XSLT's stripped copy of an available document, XTTE line numbers (), namespace-2606. Draft wins: key-070, error-0150b/c/e, iterate-006, maps-910, iterate-024.

XSLT (4.26, ): XT40 12,191 -> 12,209 passed, 309 failed. Given to 2.25: // lowered right-nested in xpath_lower.c gives duplicate nodes (5 cases), XSLT inline functions capture globals by value (2). Left: CDATA text merging with neighbours (4), a fixed invalid start-at as static XTSE0020 (2), key patterns matching namespace nodes, fn:document with strip-space "none". fn:document's trust-external default false only with an options map (6 older cases need external DTDs).

XSLT (4.25, ): XT40 12,157 -> 12,187 passed. Left: stream-available- 004/005 (a streamed open of the resource); choose-0106, type-0150 and collations-0121..0124 (casts and comparisons read the function's module, not the inner element's static context; 2.24's add_cast_namespaces covers XQuery only); fn:load-xquery-module in XSLT would link XQuery into XSLT builds (); 's single cases. Kept as the draft decides: FORG0001 in coercions, no XTTE0600, sequence JNode copies, format-number under 1.0 compatibility, XSD 1.1 regex syntax, XPDY0002 for unparsed-entity-*.
size-3 (): fn:load-xquery-module in XPath: XP40 0 -> 56 of 60 run (021, 040, 051, 067 fail); XT40 load-xquery-module-001 raises FOQM0002 per F&O 4.0 where the suite expects XQST0059 or FOQM0006.
XSLT prefixes (4.24, ): a run-time cast of a string to xs:QName still falls back on XPath's predeclared prefixes in every language (the evaluator does not know the language).

XSLT backwards compatibility (7.4, ): backwards_compatibility 111 of 124; QT4 xpath-1.0-compatibility 1 of 5. 14 cases expect fn:number-style conversion for xs:numeric parameters, which XPath 4.0 §3.4.1 restricts to xs:double (: follow the spec). 7.4b (): exsl:node-set, exsl:object-type, exsl:document; docbook-001/002 pass; docbook-004 fails with FODC0002 in xsl:source-document.

xsl:evaluate (7.3, : 73 of 83, gate 90 %): 3 need parse-html (7.10), 2 need json-doc/unparsed-text-available trust checks, 1 a UCA strength (7.15); keyword arguments to stylesheet functions from the target expression. disable-output-escaping (7.5, ): 25 of 25 run.

HTML (7.10a/b done, , ): misc-HtmlTestSuite 1,378 of 1,379, fn-parse-html 22/22, fn-html-doc 9/10; html5lib tree construction 1,749 of 1,753, tokenizer 7,045 of 7,045, encoding 82 of 82; all WHATWG multi-byte decoders; XHTML input. Left: source locations (the processor builds every tree without them), a prefixed XHTML root, XHTML that needs an external DTD.
XML 1.1 (after , ; ): query text by XML 1.1 rules is a processor option; XT40 namespace-2606/-6202 still fail in src/xslt*.

XSD (5.13 sweep 3, ): in scope 41,486 -> 41,507 of 41,518. The 11 left: XSD 1.0 rules (3), circular attribute groups the 1.1 Rec allows (1), xs:NOTATION used directly (3, w3c/xsdtests issue 12), instance tests of indeterminate schemas (4). Validation continues after a rejected element (content recovery). Not run: 92 introspection tests (all pass with xlink.xsd), 57 "queried", 50 version 1.0. The library does not follow schema location hints (5.16). 5.16 (): schema location hints in the library (schema_location_hint_node, additive in schema.h), fn:xsd-validator and fn:doc/parse-xml/document's use-xsi-schema-location, sxml validate --use-schema-location; xlink.xsd vendored (third_party/w3c-xlink): XSD 41,507 -> 41,599 passed, 92 of 92 introspection tests. XQuery validate and XSLT validation attributes still ignore hints (their specs allow it).

Duplicates merged in 7.20 (): one decoder with an error rule, Full Text on the shared feature-data path, sxml_allocator_reserve_array, and 's five cheap ones. Left: about 30 private array growers, XSLT's yes/no reader, a second UTF-8 encoder, cldr's byte_text. (Earlier, : the schema reader's own boolean and integer parsers, Gregorian day arithmetic in four places, three ways of building compile-report text, four text writers, three private heapsorts in serialization.

Performance (perf-1, ): benchmark set in tests/bench; itunes 80.6 s -> 3.4 s, XMark-All 6.73 -> 1.52 s; filter indexes for =/eq/is joins (also match="$var"); one-pass axis walks; loop-invariant hoisting. perf-2 (): XMark-All 1.55 -> 1.20 s, match="$var" 1.02 -> 0.45 s, numeric joins 2x; fast number casts, leaves computed in place, inline small lists, numeric index keys, quantifier hoisting. perf-3 (): XML parsing 15 -> 25 MB/s (tree 13 -> 21 MB/s), XMark-All -10 %; tags and plain attributes are single tokens. Left: casts cost about 1,100 instructions; hoisting of path MAPs and sort keys; the task struct copied on each push.

Distribution (dist-1, ): mise run dist builds the CLI for x86_64 and aarch64 Linux (static musl), macOS and Windows, and wasm32-wasi, as archives with SHA256SUMS. Ran here: both Linux (aarch64 under qemu), x86_64 Windows (wine), WASI. Owner: run the macOS and aarch64 Windows programs, signing and notarization, publishing. Windows has no /usr/share/zoneinfo, so the CLI there needs embedded or shipped tz data.

The book (book-1, ): docs/book/, every chapter written; Getting Started, XPath, XQuery and XSLT are complete, the others shorter. tools/check-book-examples.sh re-runs its examples; a change to CLI output the book shows updates the book. Left: chapters for a published npm package and release archives once they exist, more on XSLT 4.0's new instructions, and schema-aware XSLT output validation.

perf-4 (): the book's join 12.9 s -> 0.045 s (descendant pass, the filter index's number view, probe order); early exit through item demands and quantifier fusion (10^7 items: seconds -> 4 ms); default step bound 10^8 (about 8 s). Left: two filters in a row index only the first; FILTER/MAP over MAP not fused; demands do not enter function bodies; if/boolean read one extra item.

book-2 (): XQuery part 5 -> 11 sections, XSD part 2 -> 9; 387 examples checked. cli-2 () fixed its four CLI bugs (collection -> FODC0002, library-module error file names, undeclared xsi:type prefixes -> cvc-elt.4.1 with defaults read in the schema's namespaces, fn:trace and fn:message to standard error) and gave --context-item documents a document URI. Left: XTTE errors from XSLT validation have no line number (src/xslt_lower*.c gives no source span); content after a cvc-complex-type.2.4 rejection is not checked; the CLI ignores xsi:schemaLocation.

book-3 (): Chapter 12, a code-generation project (XSD and an API description to TypeScript with XQuery, OpenAPI with XSLT, run with Node.js). Left: a syntax error inside a string constructor's enclosed expression is reported at 1:1 of the module, not at its own place.

7.22 (): sxml:parse-code and sxml:code-languages (namespace urn:sxml; name.h SXML_NAMESPACE_SXML and processor.h sxml_source_code_feature(), additive); json, javascript (JSX), python, c, css, html, go vendored with highlights; tree-sitter/suite 630 of 639 (corpus 452/452, highlights 178/187: 7 need locals, 2 injections). sxml.wasm 9,693,235 / 2,006,198 (budget 10,000,000 / 2,800,000), CLI 11,289,043 / 2,288,933 (budget 11,500,000 / 2,500,000). Owner (2026-10-20): TypeScript/TSX and Markdown built in, a registration API, run-time language files (7.23). 7.23 (): typescript, tsx, markdown, markdown_inline built in; locals and injections (8 deep); public sxml_source_code_language and source_code_languages (tree-sitter ABI 13-15); CLI --code-language=LIBRARY (dlopen/LoadLibraryW in the platform layer). tree-sitter/suite 1,410 of 1,438 (highlights 187/187; 8 markdown_inline extensions not in upstream's default parser, 1 upstream spec.txt error). sxml.wasm 13,425,285 / 2,411,765 (budget 14,000,000), CLI 15,026,404 (15,500,000 / 2,900,000). Delayed: tree-sitter .wasm language files in JavaScript (sxml.wasm cannot link modules at run time), the native wasm store (wasmtime), the host shim and bindings (Phase 6 paused), injection.combined.

7.21 (): Earley with lookahead, Leo items, compiled classes, grammar simplification. 1 MB: log 1.12 -> 0.18 s, csv 1.25 -> 0.28 s, calc 2.14 -> 0.53 s, markdown 3.21 -> 0.30 s, right recursion fails -> 0.30 s; linear (4x input, 3.8-4.2x time); memory 90-200 bytes per character (all sets kept). Ambiguous inputs stay cubic. Suite 886 of 907 (21 not run: Unicode versions, C0 controls).

7.24 (): regular rules compiled to token automata (every end a completion; ambiguity still counted); item sets only where items are; no tree nodes for hidden parts; parse-only arrays freed before read-out. 1 MB log 0.196 s / 90 MB -> 0.059 s / 21 MB; 100 MB log 6.2 s / 1.17 GB (was over the step limit). Parser's own memory under 2 MB per MB; the rest is the XML tree. Left: the ambiguous sum (3.1 s against 's 2 s bound on this machine; owner's machine to judge).

7.25 (): Sxml.loadCodeLanguage loads tree-sitter .wasm language files (src/linker.ts reads dylink.0; sxml.wasm exports a growable table, __stack_pointer and tree-sitter's 25 wasm-stdlib functions); createProcessor({ codeLanguages }). +7,713 bytes. Not supported: pre-2021 emscripten dylink, files needing other side modules, scanner imports outside tree-sitter's list. A loaded language's memory is never freed. The Swift initializer's new field is not compiled here.

book-4 (): the codegen chapter builds a tree of the TypeScript program (XQuery, a vocabulary of our own) and prints it with an XSLT printer (one rule per element, layout in one place, a second style by import); check.xq parses the printed code with sxml:parse-code. 46 examples match, tsc --strict passes.

js-2 (): serializeTo, XQuery.runTo, transform output / resultDocumentOutput / streamedSource, chunked sinks (textSink, writableStreamSink, nodeStreamSink, outputReadableStream), chunk sources for doc($uri). 108.7 MB output: 749 MB module / 113 MB JS heap -> 481 / 4 (the tree); streamed source 10.6 / 14.6 MB. Processor.parse still takes whole text (no public incremental parse, ). Sinks cannot apply backpressure (synchronous evaluation). Swift memberwise call not compiled here.

stream-1 (): long text runs grow by doubling (arena_tree.c); method=text serialized while streamed; xml writes long text in 64 KiB parts. 20,000 x 1 KB text: out of memory -> 11.0 MB, 0.55 s. A streamed element grants 500 steps; createProcessor({ maximumEvaluationStepCount }). 93 MB streamed identity: CLI 23.2 s / 11 MB, Node 52.6 s / 10.7 MB. Left: no streamed writer for html (a tree, now linear).

stream-2 (): html and xhtml serialized while streamed (indent=no): 29.8 -> 10.9 MB for 20,000 x 1 KB; indent=yes (XSLT's html default) and XHTML with doctype-system/standalone/canonical keep the tree. cli-3 (): fn:collection/fn:uri-collection over local directories (select, recurse, on-error), --collection; XML documents only.
Platform and tooling:

item.p: macOS, Windows and MSVC have never been built; _getcwd is untested.
CI is disabled ().
The QT4 driver's list/run still have their own selection walk; selection.h is shared by the XSLT and XSD drivers.

section.title: Owner decisions open
section.p: Decided in : MIT license, npm @tinyactors/sxml, the move to the tinyactors-dev organization (URLs change with the move), Kotlin dev.tinyactors.sxml. Still the owner's: tagging and publishing releases, the copyright holder's name if not "The sxml authors", and when to move the repository. Everything else takes the proposed default ().
